executiveComp.source: Form 990 (EIN 45-3674900) FY2023 filing; Pittsburgh Post-Gazette November 2024 reporting. FY2022 breakdown was base $1,570,000 + bonus/incentive $7,020,000 per prior 990; FY2023 component breakdown not independently verified.

communityBenefit.source: Highmark Health 2023 Annual Report — $225M total community support including charity care, uncompensated care, and ~$50M in enterprise-wide corporate and foundation giving. FY2024 reported $53M community investment + ~$200M uncompensated care at AHN. Schedule H breakdowns not independently verified.

taxAdvantage.notes: Highmark Health is tax-exempt since March 2012. Highmark Inc. is subject to Pennsylvania Insurance Department Community Health Reinvestment requirements. Precise tax advantage figures require Schedule H, local assessor data, and 340B program analysis not completed here.

layoffs.description: Approximately 300 positions cut across four rounds of layoffs in 2023, including 118 in June
182 employees laid off across Pennsylvania, Delaware, West Virginia, and New York markets
47 positions eliminated while expanding payroll by 1,343 in other areas
Third round of 2024 layoffs; majority of affected positions at IT subsidiary enGen
207 employees laid off at IT subsidiary enGen, including 86 in Western Pennsylvania and 41 in central region

keyRiskFactors: Elevated medical and pharmacy utilization driving insurance operating losses
Three consecutive years of declining operating performance (FY2023 gain $338M, FY2024 loss $209M, FY2025 loss $674M)
Insurance arm reported $609M operating loss in FY2025
Industry-wide cost pressures expected to continue through 2026
S&P outlook revised to negative from stable in March 2026
